name: unstable-fractal-class-bonus-destroy-item
notes: Unstable Fractal (2o82fwl22v, PHANTASIA/CLERIC) is seeded directly onto the field, already awake (Status=2) -- its 'Hindered' enter-rested flavor is irrelevant to the activated ability under test, so seeding bypasses it (same shortcut as windrider-vanguard-class-bonus-vigor). The champion is patched to Diao Chan, Enchantress (00xbh8oc00, CLERIC) so IsClassBonusActive($player, ['CLERIC']) is true. A Backup Charger (9gv4vm4kj3, REGALIA/ITEM, memory cost 0) is seeded onto the opponent's field as a legal 'target item with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 5 or less'. Activating via CustomInput 'Activate:0' (DoActivatedAbility -> activateAbilityAbilities['2o82fwl22v:0'], GeneratedMacroCode.php) auto-rests Unstable Fractal as a static-ability [REST] cost, then ActivatedAbilityCost's case '2o82fwl22v' (Custom/GameLogic.php line ~6492) sacrifices it via DoSacrificeFighter, paying the printed '[REST], Sacrifice CARDNAME' cost. Verified live: this activation path does not separately prompt for the '(3)' Class Bonus reserve cost as an interactive payment (no MZCHOOSE for hand cards is queued) -- the hand-count>=3 check in activateAbilityPrereqs is only a legality gate. customDQHandlers['2o82fwl22v:0:ActivateAbility-1'] then destroys the chosen target; because the target is REGALIA, GraveyardAddReplacement (GameLogic.php) transparently redirects the graveyard-bound MZMove into the target's controller's Banish zone instead -- a real, generic 'Regalia leaves play to Banish, not the Graveyard' engine rule, confirmed by reading GraveyardAddReplacement, not a defect in this ability. The companion negative fixture unstable-fractal-no-class-bonus-blocked proves the Class Bonus gate: with a non-CLERIC champion, the identical Activate:0 click is accepted by the engine (not rejected as illegal) but the ability body returns immediately, leaving Unstable Fractal awake and unsacrificed and the target item untouched.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] (3), [REST], Sacrifice CARDNAME: As a Spell, destroy target item with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 5 or less.
